EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in Philosophy, Religion & Society at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Future Sun Devil,
Thank you for expressing interest in the Philosophy, Religion and Society (BA) <https://newcollege.asu.edu/philosophy-religion-and-society-degree> program at Arizona State University. This program is comprised of historical, theoretical and practical perspectives on philosophy, religion and social ethics and emphasizes social and political concerns by putting the studies of philosophy and religion into action. This interdisciplinary degree offers three areas of concentration: applied ethics, continental philosophy and religious studies. Student’s usually look to work in Child, Family & School social work, Business Ethics, Health Education, Community Health work, and Community Service Management among many other areas. By viewing the major map <https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/roadmaps/ASU00/ASRELBA/null/ALL/2016>, you can see the degree requirements outlined for graduation.
Be sure to review our admission and application requirements <https://students.asu.edu/freshman/requirements> for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format. For information on how to pay for college, please visit our scholarships page <https://newcollege.asu.edu/college-scholarships>.
It's important to find the right fit for your undergraduate program. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can visit ASU and register for a tour <https://visit.asu.edu/>.
We can’t wait to see you here at West campus! If you have any questions about New College, West campus, or one of our 35 programs, please contact our Recruitment Office through the information listed below. Thank you, and we’ll talk to you soon!
Kindest Regards,
New College Recruitment Team New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus asknewcollege@asu.edu 602-543-2890 {!Case.Thread_Id}
